:::{#def-integers}
#### Integers

The **integers** are the whole numbers,
together with their negatives and $0$:

$$\mathbb{Z} \eqdef \cb{\ldots, -3, -2, -1, 0, 1, 2, 3, \ldots}$$

An **integer** is an element of $\mathbb{Z}$.
The integers greater than $0$ are the **positive integers**,
and the integers less than $0$ are the **negative integers**.

:::
